title: Council project snapshot
description: The one authoritative Council record. It is what the wrapper returns from the project serialize channel and from a host-owned save, and what it is handed back on deserialize/load. The plugin backend's live execution state and the browser's rendered state are both derived from this; neither may hold anything that is not either present here or in flight. snapshot_revision advances on every accepted mutation and is the concurrency token every command is checked against.

project_id.description: Durable identity of this document, minted once when it is first loaded and never changed. It is what makes a chat routed against one project recognisable as that project's by a backend process that has never seen the other document, and what tells a reopened panel apart from a panel opening something else. A document written before this field existed is migrated by minting one (internal/contract/migrate.go).

definitions.description: Councils available in this project. Editing one advances its definition_revision; sessions already started keep their own embedded snapshot.

ViewState.description: User-intent view state: which session and pane the user last had open. Persisted because losing it is annoying, but it is never load-bearing — a snapshot with no 'view' key opens correctly.
